editorialSummary.heading: What Round Rock ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: Winter no-school period continues through January 4
paragraphs: Round Rock ISD’s 2026-2027 calendar begins Wednesday, August 19, and ends Thursday, May 27. Students have Labor Day and September 21 off. October 9 is a student holiday and staff-development day. Students are also off October 12, when the calendar lists staff development, elementary conferences, Indigenous Peoples’ Day and Columbus Day. Classes resume October 13, while October 19 is a separate YOU Day holiday.

Fall Break runs November 23–27. The first semester ends December 17. Students are then off December 18 through January 4: December 18 is a teacher workday, the English calendar labels December 21–31 as Winter Break and January 1 as New Year’s Day, and January 4 is a staff-development day. Classes resume January 5. Students also have February 12 and 15 off, creating a four-day weekend.

March 10 is a student holiday and staff-development day that the calendar also labels Eid al-Fitr. The third nine weeks ends March 12, followed by Spring Break March 15–19. Good Friday, March 26, is a no-school day. The published calendar lists regular school hours and does not mark May 27 as an early-release day.

comparativeInsights: October 9 and October 12 connect across the weekend, giving students four consecutive calendar days away from class before they return October 13.
The December 18 teacher workday and January 4 staff development day extend the practical winter no-school period beyond the dates labeled Winter Break.
February 12 and February 15 form another Friday-through-Monday student break, although the two weekdays have different official labels.
March 10 is a standalone student holiday before Spring Break begins March 15; it should not be treated as part of the five-day break.
The calendar lists no early-release dates and does not mark May 27 as an abbreviated day.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Round Rock ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Wednesday, August 19, 2026. Staff development and preparation run August 10-18 before students report.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Round Rock ISD in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The last day for students is Thursday, May 27, 2027. It also closes the second semester and fourth nine-week grading period.

faqs.question: What are Round Rock ISD’s regular school hours?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools run 7:35 a.m.-2:55 p.m., middle schools run 8:15 a.m.-3:35 p.m., and high schools run 9:00 a.m.-4:20 p.m.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are on the 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The district lists 170 instructional days, based on a 440-minute school day.

faqs.question: Do students attend school on Labor Day?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, is a districtwide student and staff holiday for Labor Day.

faqs.question: Why are students off September 21?
faqs.answer: September 21 is a student holiday and staff development day. The calendar also identifies the date as Yom Kippur.

faqs.question: How long is the October student break?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, October 9, through Monday, October 12, and return Tuesday, October 13. The two weekdays have separate staff-development and conference designations but create one continuous four-day break.

faqs.question: When are elementary conferences scheduled?
faqs.answer: Elementary conferences are listed for Monday, October 12. All students are off that day. The calendar also lists staff development, Indigenous Peoples’ Day and Columbus Day.

faqs.question: When are Round Rock ISD YOU Days in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: Round Rock ISD lists YOU Day student and staff holidays on October 19, 2026, and February 15, 2027. The February date is also labeled Presidents’ Day.

faqs.question: When is Round Rock ISD Fall Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Round Rock ISD labels November 23–27, 2026, as Fall Break. It falls during Thanksgiving week; students are off all five weekdays and return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Round Rock ISD Winter Break in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The English calendar labels December 21–31, 2026, as Winter Break and January 1 separately as New Year’s Day. December 18 is a teacher workday, and January 4 is a staff-development day. Students are out from Friday, December 18, through Monday, January 4, and return Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

faqs.question: When do classes resume after Winter Break?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027, for the start of the second semester and third nine weeks.

faqs.question: Does Round Rock ISD close for Martin Luther King Jr. Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, is a districtwide student and staff holiday.

faqs.question: Which dates make up the February long weekend?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, February 12, through Monday, February 15. February 12 is a staff development day, while February 15 is the YOU Day and Presidents’ Day holiday.

faqs.question: What does the Round Rock ISD calendar show for Eid al-Fitr in 2027?
faqs.answer: March 10 is a student holiday and staff-development day; the calendar also identifies the date as Eid al-Fitr.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs March 15-19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22, and schools close again Friday, March 26, for Good Friday.

faqs.question: What are the 2026-2027 nine-week grading-period dates?
faqs.answer: The periods run August 19-October 8, October 13-December 17, January 5-March 12, and March 22-May 27.

faqs.question: When does the first semester end?
faqs.answer: The first semester ends Thursday, December 17. The second semester begins when students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Are any early-release days shown on this calendar?
faqs.answer: No. The published district calendar does not identify an early-release date or a shortened schedule for the last day.

faqs.question: Where can families download the district calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF linked on this page or visit the Round Rock ISD calendars page for current downloads and revisions.

about.dataSource: This page uses Round Rock ISD’s 2026-2027 District Calendar, updated February 4, 2026, together with the district’s official calendars page. The English calendar, legend, detailed date list, school hours, and instructional-day note were cross-checked.
about.processing: Events retain separately listed official occurrences; continuous family-planning no-school periods are stored in breaks, not as replacement events. Official means a directly printed date, label or range, including a boundary explicitly marked on the calendar grid. Derived includes normalized names, internal event classifications, attendance-status mappings, editorial notes and relationships between dates. Grid legends are not event-specific official labels. Staff preparation before the first day and staff-only dates after the last student day are excluded. Same-date milestones are grouped in the page table. The 2026-2027 English PDF lists January 1 separately as New Year’s Day, while the Spanish page calls it a winter holiday; both confirm the same closure. Those source labels are preserved without extending the English Winter Break event.
about.updates: The official calendar page is monitored for revised PDFs and future years. Empty 2028-2029 and 2029-2030 routes are not created without district files.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference is not operated by Round Rock ISD. Families should confirm transportation, conferences, weather decisions, religious observance details, and campus-specific changes with the district or their child’s school.

editorialSummary.heading: Planning ahead with the 2027-2028 Round Rock ISD calendar
highlights: Students return from winter recess January 4
Spring Break connects to the March 20 student holiday
paragraphs: The 2027-2028 Round Rock ISD year begins Wednesday, August 18, and ends Thursday, May 25. Students are off for Labor Day and September 20. October 8 is a staff development and conference day, and October 11 is a districtwide YOU Day holiday, creating a Friday-through-Monday break before the second nine weeks begins October 12.

A November 1 student holiday comes before Fall Break on November 22–26. The first semester ends December 16. Students then remain out from December 17 through January 3: December 17 is a teacher workday, Winter Break runs December 20–31, and January 3 is a staff-development day. Classes and the third nine weeks begin January 4.

February 18–21 is a four-day student break: February 18 is a conference and staff-development day, and February 21 is the YOU Day and Presidents’ Day holiday. Spring Break runs March 13–17; students also have March 20 off and return March 21. Good Friday, April 14, is a no-school day. The calendar does not identify any early-release dates.

Winter Break is officially December 20-31, but adjacent student holidays extend the actual no-school period from December 17 through January 3.
The February conference day and Presidents’ Day holiday connect across the weekend, with students returning February 22.
Spring Break and the March 20 student holiday create eight consecutive calendar days without classes; students return March 21.
May 26, Memorial Day, and Juneteenth fall after the final student day and are therefore not student-calendar events.

faqs.question: What date does Round Rock ISD start school in 2027?
faqs.answer: Students begin Wednesday, August 18, 2027. Staff development and preparation take place August 9-17 before the first student day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Round Rock ISD in 2027-28?
faqs.answer: The final student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. The second semester and fourth nine-week grading period also end that day.

faqs.question: What time do Round Rock ISD schools begin and dismiss?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools are open 7:35 a.m.-2:55 p.m., middle schools 8:15 a.m.-3:35 p.m., and high schools 9:00 a.m.-4:20 p.m.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are scheduled in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not print an instructional-day total for 2027-2028. Counting the 202 scheduled weekdays between August 18 and May 25 and excluding the 32 published no-school weekdays gives 170 student attendance days.

faqs.question: Is school open on Labor Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 6, is a districtwide student and staff holiday.

faqs.question: Do students go to class on September 20?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 20, is a student holiday while staff members have professional development.

faqs.question: Which dates form the October four-day weekend?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, October 8, through Monday, October 11, and return Tuesday, October 12. The Friday is a staff development and conference day; the Monday is a districtwide YOU Day holiday.

faqs.question: When are conference days on the 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: Conference days are listed for Friday, October 8, 2027, and Friday, February 18, 2028. Students do not attend on either date.

faqs.question: What does the calendar show for Indigenous Peoples’ Day and Columbus Day?
faqs.answer: Monday, October 11, is a student and staff holiday labeled YOU Day, Indigenous Peoples’ Day, and Columbus Day.

faqs.question: When are Round Rock ISD YOU Days in 2027-28?
faqs.answer: Round Rock ISD lists YOU Day student and staff holidays on October 11, 2027, and February 21, 2028. The October date is also labeled Indigenous Peoples’ Day and Columbus Day; the February date is also Presidents’ Day.

faqs.question: Is November 1 a student holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, November 1, is a student holiday and staff development day.

faqs.question: When is Round Rock ISD Fall Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Round Rock ISD labels November 22–26, 2027, as Fall Break. It falls during Thanksgiving week, and students return Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When is Round Rock ISD Winter Break in 2027-28?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. December 17 is a teacher workday, and January 3 is a staff-development day. Students are out from Friday, December 17, through Monday, January 3, and return Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

faqs.question: What day do students return in January 2028?
faqs.answer: Classes resume Tuesday, January 4, 2028, for the start of the second semester and third nine weeks.

faqs.question: Is Martin Luther King Jr. Day a school holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 17, is a districtwide student and staff holiday.

faqs.question: What dates are included in the February student break?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, February 18, through Monday, February 21. The first date is a conference and staff development day; the second is the YOU Day and Presidents’ Day holiday.

faqs.question: Does the March 20 student holiday extend Spring Break?
faqs.answer: Yes. Spring Break is March 13-17, but students also have Monday, March 20, off for staff development. They return Tuesday, March 21.

faqs.question: When is Good Friday on this school calendar?
faqs.answer: Good Friday falls on April 14, 2028, and is a districtwide student and staff holiday.

faqs.question: What are the nine-week grading dates for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The periods run August 18-October 7, October 12-December 16, January 4-March 10, and March 21-May 25.

faqs.question: Which date closes the first semester?
faqs.answer: Thursday, December 16, is the last class day of the first semester. Students begin the second semester Tuesday, January 4.

faqs.question: Does the district calendar list any shortened school days?
faqs.answer: No. No early-release dates or special dismissal times appear on the published 2027-2028 district calendar.

faqs.question: How can parents get the official 2027-2028 PDF?
faqs.answer: Follow the official PDF link on this page or use the Round Rock ISD calendars page for the latest district copy.

faqs.question: What changed from the prior school year?
faqs.answer: Compared with 2026-2027, the 2027-2028 calendar starts August 18 instead of August 19 and ends May 25 instead of May 27. It also has a March 20 student holiday immediately after Spring Break, so students return March 21.
